english_draft: Meta Platforms' Q1 2025 Form 10-Q reports revenue of USD 42.314bn, operating income of USD 17.555bn, net income of USD 16.644bn, and operating cash flow of USD 24.026bn for the quarter ended March 31, 2025. All figures are US GAAP, USD, and come from the cited SEC filing. This analysis has no same-period pre-earnings Preview. Other metrics, guidance, and market reaction are not in the provided source and remain pending review.
reader_questions: 这是单季数还是全年数？
经营现金流为何高于净利润？
缺少哪些关键业务指标？
fact_checks: 营业利润 USD 17,555 百万、净利润 USD 16,644 百万，均同一单季与口径。
经营现金流 USD 24,026 百万，同一单季与口径；非全年，也非 Q4 单季。
